@ an input at sample * 4 under down 2 down 2 is gathered by each boundary in turn: x(c - 6 .. c - 3), 2100, 6543, 10987
@ an input at sample * 2 under down 2 down 2: the outer boundary has nothing to gather, the inner takes the 2 values of its part before its tick
@ two inputs that are gathered by the two boundaries and by the inner one only are two rings with their own windows
@ a block input gathered through the two boundaries is the parameter of each frame of the window
@ a port at sample * 8 is gathered by the boundaries in turn, the order of the ratios and the number of the boundaries change the window
@ an output at sample * 4 dealt by two boundaries is read in order from the tick, with the parameter of the frame of the run
@ an output at sample * 2 under down 2 down 2 is two values of sample / 2 held: p p p+1 p+1, the run of the frame 4 reads p of its frame
@ an output at sample * 4 under down 2 down 4 is 4 values of sample / 4 over 8 frames, each held for 2 frames
@ an output at sample * 8 is dealt in order whatever the order of the ratios and the number of the boundaries
@ a port that is gathered and an output that is dealt in one head: the 4 elements of x(c - 6 .. c - 3) come back reversed from the tick
@ the head reads the time quot(T, 4) and its port gathers the caller's time T by the two boundaries
@ an output dealt by the head that reads the time is the number of the frame: the head at T = 4 q reads q and deals 4 q .. 4 q + 3
@ a chain of two boundaries inside a part that runs under down 2: the part's frame q is the caller's frame 2 q
@ the replicas of a par~ have their own rings, and the arm of an if~ that is not taken goes on gathering
process 1 params c=true frames=5 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000 0x40800000 0x40a00000]

- the calls of process cut the run anywhere, a call of 0 frames too: the same values for a gather and a deal at two boundaries (§13.4)
- twelve calls of one frame give the same
- reset after any number of frames, at a tick or between: the rings, the arrays and the counter are those of a state just made
@ reset after 6 frames: the time of the head and the caller's time in its port start again from 0
